conditions: Normal rewards 14-18 Pearls per clear, 20-24 on Steel Path. Resource Boosters do not increase them.
Do not buy a blueprint as soon as you can afford it: wait until your Pearls cover every blueprint still missing, so a later drop cannot duplicate a purchase.
Save two offerings for the Oni's invulnerable phase; carry one in Warframe and one as Operator, then deposit both at once.
bonuses: The offering timer pauses only while Infested stand in the circle, so area control at both dwellings keeps offerings coming.

disclosures.title: the zero-luck ceiling
disclosures.body: Four blueprints cost 330 Pearls, then crafting consumes another 102. At 14-18 Pearls a clear that is roughly 25-30 runs.

conditions: Spend only on the blueprints still missing once you have enough Pearls for all of them.
